charges_service_id_period_key_unique.name: charges_service_id_period_key_unique
charges_service_id_period_key_unique.where: "charges"."service_id" is not null and "charges"."period_key" is not null

charges_status_amount_paid_consistency.name: charges_status_amount_paid_consistency
charges_status_amount_paid_consistency.value:
(
        "charges"."status" = 'cancelled'
        or ("charges"."status" = 'pending' and "charges"."amount_paid_minor" = 0)
        or ("charges"."status" = 'partial' and "charges"."amount_paid_minor" > 0 and "charges"."amount_paid_minor" < "charges"."amount_minor")
        or ("charges"."status" = 'paid' and "charges"."amount_paid_minor" >= "charges"."amount_minor")
      )

charges_period_key_consistency.name: charges_period_key_consistency
charges_period_key_consistency.value:
(
        ("charges"."period_key" is null or ("charges"."service_id" is not null and btrim("charges"."period_key") <> ''))
        and
        ("charges"."generated_automatically" = false or ("charges"."service_id" is not null and "charges"."period_key" is not null))
      )

expenses_recurring_period_unique.name: expenses_recurring_period_unique
expenses_recurring_period_unique.where: "expenses"."recurring_expense_id" is not null and "expenses"."period_key" is not null

expenses_authenticated_delete.name: expenses_authenticated_delete
expenses_authenticated_delete.using:
(select auth.uid()) = "expenses"."owner_id"
        and "expenses"."recurring_expense_id" is null
        and "expenses"."generated_automatically" = false
        and "expenses"."status" in ('planned', 'pending')

expenses_paid_date_status_consistency.name: expenses_paid_date_status_consistency
expenses_paid_date_status_consistency.value:
(
        ("expenses"."status" = 'paid' and "expenses"."paid_date" is not null)
        or
        ("expenses"."status" <> 'paid' and "expenses"."paid_date" is null)
      )

expenses_recurrence_consistency.name: expenses_recurrence_consistency
expenses_recurrence_consistency.value:
(
        ("expenses"."recurring_expense_id" is null and "expenses"."period_key" is null and "expenses"."generated_automatically" = false)
        or
        ("expenses"."recurring_expense_id" is not null and "expenses"."period_key" is not null and btrim("expenses"."period_key") <> '')
      )

services_billing_consistency.name: services_billing_consistency
services_billing_consistency.value:
(
        ("services"."billing_type" = 'one_time' and "services"."billing_frequency" = 'one_time' and "services"."billing_day" is null and "services"."automatic_charge_generation" = false)
        or
        ("services"."billing_type" = 'recurring' and "services"."billing_frequency" <> 'one_time' and "services"."billing_day" is not null)
      )

tasks_parent_id_recurrence_key_unique.name: tasks_parent_id_recurrence_key_unique
tasks_parent_id_recurrence_key_unique.where: "tasks"."parent_id" is not null and "tasks"."recurrence_key" is not null

tasks_recurrence_consistency.name: tasks_recurrence_consistency
tasks_recurrence_consistency.value:
(
        ("tasks"."recurring" = true and "tasks"."recurrence" is not null and "tasks"."parent_id" is null and "tasks"."recurrence_key" is null)
        or
        ("tasks"."recurring" = false and "tasks"."recurrence" is null and "tasks"."parent_id" is null and "tasks"."recurrence_key" is null)
        or
        ("tasks"."recurring" = false and "tasks"."recurrence" is null and "tasks"."parent_id" is not null and "tasks"."recurrence_key" is not null and btrim("tasks"."recurrence_key") <> '')
      )

tasks_completion_consistency.name: tasks_completion_consistency
tasks_completion_consistency.value:
(
        ("tasks"."status" = 'pending' and "tasks"."completed_at" is null)
        or
        ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' and "tasks"."completed_at" is not null)
      )
